Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha kumanya ki aha bikwaata aha vekita abaana bashemereire kuba nibamanyireho kubaasa kwetegyereza amaani g'ahaagati gariyo nigagumira omubiri oguri kugyenda omu ruyo rw'omuringo ogurikushushana.

Omu kweegyereza amaani g'ahaagati (centripetal force) egumira omubiri ogurikugyenda omu ruyo rw'omuringo ogurikushushana, abaana nibeetaaga kumanya:
- Omuringo gw'okuta omutaano aha vekita - kuba vekita eriho omutaano (magnitude/obunene)
- Omuringo gw'okuta omutaano aha vekita niho harikureeta okutegerezebwa kw'amaani

Ebigarukamu ebindi:
- A (Okugyibwamu) - kino kirikukwata aha direction yonka
- B (Cross product) - kino kirikukwata aha bimwe ebikuru nk'angular momentum
- D (Okutaanura omu bice bya Karuteziani) - kino kirikukwata aha components

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'okumanya omutaano gw'amaani g'ahaagati ngu:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza aha omumanyiso ki ahaabaana abeeshuli erikuremesa omumanya gw'ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes.

Ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes kirikugamba ngu ekintu ekiri omu maizi kirimu oburemeezi obukwata aha obunene bw'amaizi oburikurugamu (buoyant force). Oburemeezi obu nibwesigamira aha bwomeezi bw'amaizi oburikurugamu, ti aha buremeezi bw'ekintu kyenka.

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Tiburikwata aha buremeezi bw'amaizi - Eki kiremesa omumanya

B. Obwiire obu ekintu ekiri omu maizi kirimu nibwo burikukwata aha maani g'amaizi - Eki kirikugarukamu nk'ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes

C. Nibyesigamira aha bwomeezi obu gurimu - Eki kiremesa omumanya (tikyesigamira aha bwomeezi bw'ekintu)

D. Nikwesigamira aha mitero y'ekintu - Eki kiremesa omumanya

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'omumanyiso oguremesa omumanya gw'ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes ni:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa agira ekigyendererwa: "Shoboorora ebintu ebitari bimwe ebirikubaho buri izooba orikukoresa omusingi gwa Bernoulli."

Omusingi gwa Bernoulli gukwatiraine n'okukwata kw'emizingo y'amaizi/empepo - omu buzima bwa buri izooba, gukwatiraine n'ebintu nk'okuguruka kw'endege, okukwata kw'omuyaga, n'ebindi.

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kushoborora emigararuro ya Bernoulli - kiri kya butereevu kuruga aha kigyendererwa
B. Akamashine k'okushuukira ebihogo - tikakwatiraine na Bernoulli
C. Okugwa kw'amaizi okuva mu taapu - tikukwatiraine na Bernoulli (kiri gravity)
D. Ecupa ya pulasitiki eremwa omu omuyaga ogwayotsibwa - eki kikwatiraine na Bernoulli (omuyaga ogwanguya okukwata)

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'akashatu ari kukora ekizibu ky'okuhandiika okucungura ekitongole ky'okutegyereza ebikwatiraine n'okutegyereza okurikwinga. Omugasho ni "Nibakoresa emigararo y'ekibaro erikushoborora omuringo gw'okutegyereza ogurikwinga ogutahinduka kushobora oburemeezi obutari bumwe."

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Kumanya omwendego gw'omutindo gw'okuzunguruka - Eki kirikukurata okuzunguruka kwa kintu
B. Kumanya omuringo n'omwinganiso gw'obureingwa - Eki kirikukurata emigararo y'ekibaro
C. Kubala obwangu bw'akameme - Eki kirikukurata okwingana aha izooba omu buraayo obutari bumwe
D. Okurata formula y'okubara omushoberera - Eki kirikukurata formula yonka

Ekibuuzo kirikwenda ekintu ekirikukiraho kwemerera "okukoresa emigararo y'ekibaro erikushoborora omuringo gw'okutegyereza ogurikwinga ogutahinduka kushobora oburemeezi obutari bumwe."

Eky'okugarukamu C kirikwereka obwangu bw'akameme omu buraayo obutari bumwe (R na R/2), ekyo nikyokoresa emigararo y'ekibaro okushoborora omuringo gw'okwingana omu buraayo obutari bumwe.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akwenda abegyeswa bahikane eky'okuhinduka okurikukora omu bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi bwabwo.

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Kworeka emitwarize y'ebintu ebirikurugwa omu kintu ekiriyo nikyeyenda omu mucwe gw'obutareeba - Eki kirikukwata aha kutareeba, tikiri aha bwiini bw'obutini.

B. Kushoboorora omutaano gw'ebintu ebirikurugamu omu kashushani k'omukanda gw'obumanzi bw'enkyerere - Eki kirikukwata aha kutunguka kw'ebintu omu bumanzi, tikiri aha bwiini bw'obutini.

C. Kucuunda aha maani g'okureebana n'okukwatana agari omunda y'akacwe kamatomu - Eki kirikukwata aha maani g'atomu, tikiri aha bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi.

D. Kwetegekereza akameeza akarikukwata aha miringo y'okubumbuka kw'ebintu - Eki kirikukwata aha miringo y'okubumbuka (states of matter) n'okuhinduka kwabyo, ekirikukurataho bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa yegyesa aha mutwe gw'ekicweka ky'obutaguruka bw'ebintu (Chemical Equilibrium), n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirikukorwa omu kwegaita kw'ebintu. Akoresa kashushani akarikworeka obunji bw'ekintu n'obwire.

Ekibuuzo kirikubuuza: Mubuzo ki omwegyesa orikubaasa kubuuza kubaasa kuhwera abegyegyi kwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu omu kwegaita kw'ebintu kuraba omu kushoborora ekishushani?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Aha ekirikuruga omu by'okubanza n'ebirikurugamu aha guraafu - Ekibuuzo eki kirikukwatiraine n'okureeba okuhinduka omu bunji

B. Aha obungi bw'amaanyi g'ebintu - Ekibuuzo eki kirikukwatiraine n'amaanyi, tikirikukwatiraine n'okuhinduka omu bunji

C. Aha kiro kiro eby'okubangaanisa - Ekibuuzo eki kirikukwatiraine n'okurekeraaho kw'ebintu, tikirikukwatiraine n'okuhinduka omu bunji

D. Aha oburemeezi omu kubumbwa n'okukozesebwa - Ekibuuzo eki kirikukwatiraine n'oburemeezi, tikirikukwatiraine n'okuhinduka omu bunji

Ekigarukamu ekikwatiraine n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu kuraba omu kashushani ni:

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugyezibwa areeba ngu abeeshumi batunga omuhendo gwa pH oguri ahansi y'efuuru bwanyima y'akashusho ka titration. Ekibuuzo nikigamba ngu ni murimo ki ogurikukurataho oguraagira omugyezibwa kugarura abeeshumi kumariiriza okuzooka ekikoomi ky'okuringaaniza?

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Yenda abeshomesa omu maabaraato - Eki tikiri kintu ekikurataho kugumaho

B. Mugambe ngu kipimo kya pH kikyombekirwe kurugiirira aha muhendo murungi gw'obwingi - Eki nikigamba aha theory

C. Mubagambire oku murikubaasa kushoboorora omuhendo gw'emooli ezirikushigara - Eki nikigamba aha calculations n'eky'okureeberaho ekirikurataho nikireeba ngu calculations za moles zirikukora atya omu titration

D. Koresa kompyuta omwegyesibwa arikuta omuhendo - Eki nikigamba aha technology

Eky'okureeberaho ekirikurataho nikireeba ngu calculations za moles zirikukora atya omu titration, kandi nikireeba ngu abeeshumi barikubasa kumanya oku barikubaasa kushoboorora moles ezirikushigara omu buri stage ya titration.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa sekenda ari kukora aha mugasho gw'okwegyesa "Kushoborora embeera y'okuringaniza erikuhikwaho enyikirizo z'eby'omwiisho" omu kiraasi erikukwatanisa n'omutwe gw'okuringaniza kw'eby'omwiisho. 

Abegyeswa barikubuuza: "Ebirikutwarwa n'ebirikurugamu nibihika aha mbeera y'okuringaniza omu bwabo?"

Ekibuuzo eki kirikworeka ngu abegyeswa barikwetegereza aha nkora y'okuringaniza kw'eby'omwiisho - harimu okumanya ngu omu mbeera y'okuringaniza, omuhendo gw'ebintu ebirikutwarwa (reactants) n'ebirikurugamu (products) nibarikuringanira.

Omuringo ogusingire omu kwegyesa ekyo ni:

**D** - Kukora omukoro gw'okugezesa ogurikwija kukuha obushoboorozi bw'okuragura omuhendo gw'ebintu ebirikwetaba omu mutengo, orikuruga aha muhendo gwabyo ogw'okutandika.

Ekyo nikireeta abegyeswa okukora obugezesa bw'okupima omuhendo gw'ebintu mbere n'enyima y'okuringaniza, okukakasa ngu omuhendo gurikuringanira - ekyo nikyo kirikugarukamu ekibuuzo kyabo.

**D**

Ninkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikubaasa kubuuza ekibuuzo ki abegi kureetera kuta omutima aha biteekateeko byabo kuruga omu kumanyisa oku?

Ninkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Obushushu nibukora buta aha ntebeekanisa y'omuringo? - Eki ni kibuuzo ky'okumanyisa/ky'obumanyire.

B. Okurugyererana orukuhuumire kurikukwatana kita n'entebeekanisa y'omuringo? - Eki ni kibuuzo ky'okumanyisa/ky'obumanyire.

C. Ahabw'enki obumanyire kugamba aha bintu ebirikukara n'ebirikuhoora, omu muringo ogu, aha kacaali ekirikuhyoora na kacaali ekirikukara? - Eki kibuuza "ahabw'enki" - kireetera abegi kwetegereza n'okushushanya biteekateeko byabo, kugamba ensi yaabo y'okumanya.

D. Omubumbo gw'omutindo gw'obushuushu bw'omuheru n'obushuushu bw'ebintu ebiri omu birago nikiki? - Eki ni kibuuzo ky'okumanyisa/ky'obumanyire.

Ekibuuzo ekireetera abegi "kuta omutima aha biteekateeko byabo" ni ekyo ekirikubaabuuza kwetegereza n'okushushanya, ti ekibuuzo ky'obumanyire honka.

**C**

Nkuteekateeka ekibuuzo:

Abanyeshuri b'omu mwaka ogw'okushatu nibetebeekanisa lipooti y'ekicweka aha kucweera ekirikwetwa "Ebintu Ebirikukwata aha Muhendo gw'Ekyetengo."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni by'endaaba ki ebi baraabe bamaze kwega kubaasa kushoboorora ebirugiremu ebi baatoonire?

Omu kucweera aha "Ebintu Ebirikukwata aha Muhendo gw'Ekyetengo," abanyeshuri nibeetegereza engeri ebintu ebirikukwata n'okukora omu muhendo gw'ekyetengo - nk'oku ebintu birikuhinduka, birikukoragana, n'emiringo y'ebintu ebirikubaho omu kyetengo.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa abuuza abegyesi kutunga omurimo ogurikukurataho:
- Handiika engyenderwaho y'abarastani yona ey'ebintu ebiri omunshonga y'amaizi (H₂O) na amonia (NH₃)
- Shushani emishushani ya Lewis erikuhikaana na buli nshonga
- Yombeka emishushani y'enshonga zoona n'ebumba n'obuti bw'emichwe nk'oku biri omu muringo gwazo
- Shaho okushushana n'okutashushana aha miringo y'enshonga zombi

Omurimo ogu gurikukurataho:
- Okushushana emishushani ya Lewis (ebirikworeka okugabana kw'ebipooli)
- Okuyombeka emishushani y'enshonga (ebirikworeka omuringo gw'enshonga omu kabindo)
- Okugeraageranya emiringo y'enshonga zombi

Ekibuuzo kibuuza: Ni nshonga ki ezirikuba zirikushobora kucungurwa n'omurimo ogurikugambwaho?

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'omurimo ogu ni:

**C** - Shwijuma okugabana kw'obungi bw'obutini oburikukora emiramu omu molekyu nk'oku kyorekwa omumanyiso g'omuringo gw'okwegomba kw'amasannyalaze g'omu kabindo k'aha rubaju (VSEPR)

Omurimo gurikukurataho okuyombeka emishushani y'enshonga kurugiirira aha VSEPR theory, ebirikworeka okugabana kw'ebipooli n'emiringo y'enshonga.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akwenda abegyesi kwega aha kubara obwire bw'ekintu ekirimu obutwa obwa radioactive (half-life).

Nkwetegyereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Shuuruuraana omu mwirondoozi - Eki nikireeta okwega kw'omusingi ahariho, kyonka tikireeta kubara obwire bw'ekintu.

**B.** Ndyemeza ngu obwingi bw'akanya akarikukira... nibigwa - Eki nikireeta okukora experiment y'okureeba engingo y'okugwa kw'ebintu, kandi nikireeta kubara n'okwetegyereza obwire bw'ekintu (half-life concept) omu ngingo y'okukora.

**C.** Kuhuumuriza ebiri omu meza y'ebiro - Eki nikireeta okusoma data yonka, tikireeta abegyesi kukora n'okwetegyereza omu ngingo y'okukora.

**D.** Teerera okuhinduka kw'ekintu - Eki nikireeta observation yonka, tikireeta kubara obwire bw'ekintu.

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyo kihikire kuba nikireeta abegyesi kukora experiment, kubara, n'okwetegyereza engingo ya half-life omu ngingo y'okukora.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi w'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu ishomero erikuru aine kucungura okwetegyereza kw'abegyeshwa aha **bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu omu muringo ogurikuroraanisa omu kubaririra kw'ebirikurungo** (stoichiometry).

Omu stoichiometry, omuringo ogukuru ni **omugano/omuhendo gw'ebipimo bya mole** hagati y'ebintu ebikozesebwa (reactants) n'ebintu ebireetwawo (products). Eki nikyo kirikureetera abegyeshwa kumanya ngu bamanyire ebi baayegire - okumanya omugano gw'ebipimo bya mole omu kubaririra kw'ebirikurungo.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni:

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'eky'okuna arikuyenda kureetera abeeshuri obwengye bw'okutebeekanisa ebintu omu mbeera z'ebintu.

Nkureeba eky'okugarukamu kyona:

**A.** Omulingo gw'okukora okucweeka - okworeka ngu oburemu bw'ekintu tibuhinduka eki kiyemeire (conservation of mass/matter)

**B.** Ahandiike n'okushuura omuringo - okumanya yaaba amaizi gahinduka obwingi obu gahinduka embeera

**C.** Okukoresa ekipima bwihotero - kureeba obwiihotero bw'amaizi obu buhinduka

**D.** Okushuururwa kw'amaizi omu bwihumbi bw'omukaaro

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha **"okutebeekanisa ebintu"** (classification/categorization) omu **"mbeera z'ebintu"** (states of matter).

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyoreka omurimo ogurikureetera abeeshuri okutebeekanisa/okumanya embeera z'amaizi (solid, liquid, gas) n'okumanya ngu amaizi gahinduka embeera.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ashemereire kushwijuma omulingo omwana atungireho oburemeezi bw'eky'okureeberaho eki ekya Corporality n'Okugyeenda: Aronda nari ayoleka omuhanda gw'ebintu eby'omunda nk'omutima, amahaho, obwongo.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba aha kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda y'omubiri (omutima, amahaho, obwongo).

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Kureeba ebinda by'omubiri gw'omuntu n'ebumba - Eki nikishemereire kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda.

B. Omwana atoore ekicweka ky'omubiri - Eki nikigamba aha obushoborozi bw'okugyenda, tikirikukurataho ebintu eby'omunda.

C. Kuta omubaanzi gw'ebicweka by'omubiri - Eki nikishemereire kuronda ebintu eby'omunda.

D. Kureeba vidiyo - Eki nikishemereire kuronda ebintu eby'omunda.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisingire nk'A, ahabwokuba nikishemereire abaana kureeba ebinda (models/diagrams) by'omubiri gw'omuntu n'ebumba, ekyo nikishemereire kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda nk'omutima, amahaho, obwongo.

**A**

Nkurikuteekateeka ekibuuzo:

Abaana b'omu Pre-kindergarten nibateekamu etabaaza omu izooba kureeba ekirikubaho. Enyima, nibakora okuteebereza kandi nibabishushaniisa omu katarabo.

Ekibuuzo: Nkyukakyuka ki y'embeera y'ekintu egi abaana barikubaasa kureeba?

Nkurikuteekateeka ebigaruzo:

A. Okushaanisa - Eki nikitwariramu ekintu kukoma kuba kiri omu mbeera y'okushaana (solid)

B. Okwehisa - Eki nikitwariramu ekintu kukoma kuba kiri omu mbeera y'amazi (liquid)

C. Kuguma - Eki nikitwariramu ekintu kuguma omu mbeera yekyo

D. Okuhinduka omukka kugira amazi - Eki nikitwariramu ekintu kuhinduka kukoma kuba mukka

Etabaaza omu izooba erikwehisa (erikutunguka) - amazi g'omu tabaaza garikuhinduka kugira omukka (evaporation/okuhinduka omukka).

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa asoma aha mutwe ogurikugamba aha "Okuteekateeka nk'omuhangaika" - abaana bakora omutwaro omunungi omu by'okurabamu, okukora engeyeso, n'okwega ebikwatiraine n'omuringo gw'abahangaika. Barikwega obwomeezi bw'okwetegyereza n'okucumita.

Ekibuuzo: Kiki ekirikubaasisa kuteeraniza obwomeezi obu omu baana?

Nkwetegyereza ebigaruzo:

A. Ekipe ey'okukoresa omuntu kwetegyereza, okuhandiika ebintu bisya - eki kirikugamba aha kikoresho kimwe kyonka

B. Eky'okukuratira, kworeka ebiteekateeko by'okubanza n'okwetegyereza kw'okugezesa, hanyuma ogeranise data - eki kirikugamba aha okukora assessment n'okugeraageranya

C. Ekitabo ky'okutebeekanisa, ekirikukora nk'omugufu gw'entebeekanisa n'ebiteekateeko by'okubanza, obwomeezi nibukurikiranwa - eki kirikugamba aha portfolio/ekitabo ekirikukurikirana obwomeezi bw'omwana omu bwire

D. Ebikoresho by'okukorakorana n'okwetegyereza ebirikworobiya okucuurura omuhanda - eki kirikugamba aha interactive tools

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **C** - Ekitabo ky'okutebeekanisa (portfolio) ekirikukurikirana obwomeezi bw'omwana omu bwire, kirikubaasa kuteeraniza obwomeezi bw'okwetegyereza n'okucumita.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akoreire aha mugasho gw'okwegyesa ogurikugira ngu "Kukoragana omu mbeera za butoosha, omu bikorwa ebirikugumaho omu kukuza eby'obutonde oburikugumaho." Yaagabana n'abaana ebikorwa by'okwegyera (kureeba vidiyo, kukora empapura, kutaayaayira esente za risaikulingi, n'ebindi). Hanyuma, aine kwetegyereza omugasho ogu yaatooranize.

Ekibuuzo: Nkoreki omuringo gw'okwetegyereza guraabe gubwire kukoresa okumanyisa oku omugasho ogu gwatiinisiibwe?

Nkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Okushimisha ebikorwa abaana abarikukora omu bwire obutungiire (okuzimya amateeka g'amaizi, okutorora empapura)

B. Oorobereza ebirango, orikurugiira omu ku kondooza eby'abaana obwo barikuteeraho omutima n'orugano orurikukwata aha bikorwa ebirikugumya obutonde

C. Okuchekiresti yaaba abaana nibashobora kwetantaza aha bishushani by'emikoro erikukwasa n'emikoro etaarikukwasa omu butonde (okukoresa ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omurundi gwa kabiri, okuta amataka omu byondo)

D. Ongyeera amakuru omu rurembo rw'okucweekereza orurikukoresibwa kucweekereza ebi abaana barikugamba n'ebiteekateeko byabo obwo barikureeba vidiyo

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi ni:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akwenda abeeshuri bakumye ekigyendererwa: "Kwetegyereza Eiragiiriro ry'ebiragiro 3 omu bikorwa ebirikukwatwaho" - Kukendeeza (Reduce), Kukoresa Butoosha (Reuse), Kuhindura (Recycle).

Omweeshuri yahandiikire:
1. Kukoresa obukoore bw'okwetantaza oburikweshamba
2. Kubyara ebimera omu byanzi by'amata
3. Kwahukanisa n'okutoorana ebyanzi ebirikwija kutaangwa omu ka

Ekibuuzo: Ni buha buhabuzi buki oburikubaasa kuleetera omweeshuri kuteeraho n'okumwebembera okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa?

Nkwetegereza eby'okugarukamu:

**A** - Ekubuuza aha R zoona, n'okumubuuza aha kukoresa obutungi n'okutebeekanisa muringo mushya - Eki kikumya omweeshuri kwetegyereza ngu R 3 zaabaire zitakwataine gye aha by'okugarukamu bye.

**B** - Ekumuha amakuru g'ebigambo bishatu (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) n'okumubuuza aha by'okubikora omu magara - Eki kikumya omweeshuri kwega amakuru agakwatiraine n'okubiteekamu omu bikorwa.

**C** - Ekubuuza aha miringo y'okutaaho omu ishomero n'okureetera omwegi - Eki kikumya omweeshuri kwetegyereza application omu context y'ishomero.

**D** - Ekubuuza ahabw'enki ebikorwa ebi birungi n'obw'okukendeza obucafu - Eki kikumya omweeshuri kwetegyereza importance y'ebiragiro ebi omu general.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisinga obwengye ni **A** - kuba kikumya omweeshuri kwetegyereza ngu R 3 zaabaire zitakwataine gye aha by'okugarukamu bye, n'okumubuuza okutebeekanisa muringo mushya.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Turikwetaaga kumanya omurimo oguhikire abeeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okushatu gw'amashomero okukoresa kushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana n'omwezi gukinga izooba (solar eclipse) n'okikyerereza banyaabwe.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Kukoresa orupapura n'erangi - Eki tikiri kushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana, nikyo kuhandiika honka.

**B.** Kukoresa etoroshi n'efoomu - Eki nikushoborra emiterere y'ekisiizi, kyonka tikiri kushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana n'omuringo gw'eclipse.

**C.** Kukoresa akapiira akato n'akataara k'omumaiso - Eki nikushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana! Abeeshuri nibareeba oku omushana gw'eizooba gurikuhinduka aha ibaara (ensi) omu bwire obutari bumwe, nikwo kurikushoborra omuringo gw'eclipse.

**D.** Kukoresa emitwe yaabo n'akabuumbo - Eki nikushoborra emiterere y'eclipse, kyonka tikiri kushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana n'omuringo gw'okwiruka kw'omwezi.

Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire ni **C** - nikukoresa akapiira akato nibakiija omu maisho g'akataara k'omumaiso, nibareeba oku ebimurikire aha ibaara birikuhinduka omu bwire obutari bumwe, nikwo kurikushoborra omuringo gw'eclipse ogurikwingana n'obwire.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi arikwenda kucweeka obuhame bw'okucweeka aha kicweka kikuru: "Naamanya ebicweka by'omubiri gwe bimwe naayorekyezaaho arikubiranga."

Ekigyendererwa ni kumanya ebicweka by'omubiri n'okubiranga (okubiyorekyezaaho).

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

**A.** Omwana yaizire haihi n'endorerwamu, omukuru amubuuza ebicweka by'omu maisho ge - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya ebicweka by'omu maisho.

**B.** Omukuru abuuza omwana aha bw'emitwarize n'amugambira kukwata omutwe gwe - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya omutwe.

**C.** Omukuru arikwimba enyimba ezirikukwatana n'ebicweka by'omu maisho, arikubikoraho aha mubiri gwe wenka naareeba yaaba omwana nabigarukamu - Eki kirikureeta okwega kw'okugarukamu, omwana arikureeba n'okugarukamu ebikorwa ebirikukwata aha bicweka by'omubiri.

**D.** Omukuru naakora ebikorwa ebirikukwata aha bice by'omubiri (okukoma omukono, okuhindura ebigyere n'omutwe) reero yaabuuza abaana kumutooreza ebikorwa ebi - Eki kirikureeta okumanya ebicweka bitarikugana n'okubikoraho (kumutooreza).

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **C** - kuba kirikureeta okumanya ebicweka by'omubiri n'okubigarukamu/okubiranga arikubikoraho.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi w'ekicweka kya kindergarten araganisa omu purojekiti y'eby'amagara ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurira aha kintu eki: "Kuhimba ebiteekateeko aha birikurugamu omu bintu ebirikubaho omu butonde ebi orikureeba, orikwesigamira aha bumanyi n'obuhangwa ebi waabaire nooyegaho."

Ekigyendererwa eki nikyetegyereza ngu abaana:
- Bahimbe ebiteekateeko (bakore hypotheses/predictions)
- Aha birikurugamu omu bintu ebirikubaho omu butonde
- Ebi barikureeba
- Bakozese obumanyi n'obuhangwa ebi baabaire baayegaho

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Yolesa vidiyo - Abaana barikugamba aha byabaire byabaho kwaabo (kugarukamu aha byabaire byabaho)

B. Yoreka enyanja omu kacupa - Abaana barikureeba ekirikubaho kandi babuuzibwa ekibuuzo aha ekyaabaireho (observation + explanation)

C. Bakore orusozi rw'omuriro - Barikukora eby'okureeberaho, barikureeba, kandi babuuzibwa kushoboorora ekyabaire kyabaho (hands-on experiment, observation, explanation based on what they learned)

D. Oruziga rw'okuganiira - Barikureeba eby'okureeberaho kandi babuuzibwa kushoboorora ekyabaire kyabaho

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyo kirikukwasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki ahabwokuba abaana:
- Barikukora eby'okureeberaho (hands-on)
- Barikureeba ekirikubaho
- Barikuhimba ebiteekateeko/kushoboorora okurikusiingana aha byabaire baayegaho

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa nabuuza abaana, "Kiki ekirikubaho?" Antonio nagira ati, "Ninkunda emihogo ei orikweteraho."

Omugingo gw'okwega ni: "Kugezesa n'ebintu ebirikugattwa hamwe n'ebirikushaanwa omu mazi..."

Antonio tagarukire ekibuuzo ky'omwegyesa - yaagira aha kusiima emibala ahali ky'okugamba aha ekirikubaho omu kugezesa.

Omwegyesa arikwetaaga kumukonyera kugarukira aha mugingo gw'okwega - okwetegyereza ngu amajuta n'amaizi tibyebumbire hamwe, kandi emihogo (amafuta) agumaho nk'ebipooli.

Ninkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Nikusiima, nanye nkasiima - kandi yamugarukiza aha mugingo (amaizi na amafuta tibyebumbire)
B. Nikusiima emibala - kandi yamubuuza aha ekirikubaho (zigumaho nk'ebipooli)
C. Nikusiima emiringo - kandi yamubuuza okureeberaho (enjura omu amauta n'eriya omu maizi)
D. Nikusiima emibala - nanye ninkureeba ekirikubaaho

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyo kirungi ahabwokuba:
- Kikusiima Antonio
- Kikumugarukiza aha mugingo gw'okwega (okureeba enjura/emihogo omu amauta n'eriya omu maizi)
- Kikumukonyera kwetegyereza obutari bwebumbire

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikwenda kugyeragyeranisa mashini z'eifaakitore n'ebicweka by'omubiri, kandi arikwenda orugero orurikugyeragyerana na "cytoskeleton" (omugongo gw'omubiri gw'ekisenge).

Cytoskeleton ni muundo gw'obutoonde oguri omunda y'ekisenge ogurikuha ekisenge obushusho bwakyo, obukomeezi, kandi gurikuyamba omu kuhindura n'okutambura kw'ebintu omunda y'ekisenge.

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Ekyeruro ekihindura ebintu - Eki kirikugyeragyerana n'omurimo gw'okuhindura, ti gw'okukomeeza obushusho

B. Omukura ogurikukonyera obutebeekane kugumaho omunda y'eifaakitore - EKI nikyokira! Cytoskeleton kirikuha ekisenge obukomeezi n'obushusho nk'oku omukura ogurikukomeeza eifaakitore

C. Ekicweka ky'okugenzesa - Eki kirikugyeragyerana na nucleus, ti cytoskeleton

D. Ekyeruro ekishobora kuteeraho akarembo - Eki kirikugyeragyerana n'ebindi ebicweka

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda abeeshuli kwetegyereza osmosis (omuringo gw'okutwara amaizi ogutiina maani). Abeeshuli baine oburemeezi bw'okwetegyereza oku, kandi omwegyesa atebeekaine omurimo. Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni muringo ki ogusaaniire kwongyera aha kwetegyereza kw'abeeshuli aha mukoro gwa osmosis?

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

**A.** Kucumuura ebitakuli omu maizi g'omunyu (0.9%), kupima oburemu enyima y'eminute 15, kugyerageranisa n'oburemu obw'okubanza - Eki kirikworeka osmosis (amaizi garikwingira/kusooka omu bitakuli).

**B.** Kucumuura ekyaayi omu maizi amaruru n'omu maizi g'okushushu - Eki kirikworeka diffusion (okusiigira), si osmosis.

**C.** Kwijuuza ebeka n'amaizi otaatseho obwojo - Eki kirikworeka diffusion y'obwojo, si osmosis.

**D.** Ekyombo kirimu ebicweka bibiri eby'ahukaniisiibwe oruhu rw'akacwamu, omunyu omu kicweka kimwe, amaizi garikutwara kurugiirira omu ruhu - Eki kirikworeka osmosis (amaizi garikutwara kurugiirira omu ruhu okugenda omu kicweka kirimu omunyu).

Ebigaruzo A n'D byombi birikworeka osmosis, ariko **D** niyo esaaniire zaidi kuba erimu:
- Oruhu rw'akacwamu (semi-permeable membrane)
- Okutwara kw'amaizi kurugiirira omu concentration gradient
- Ekyombo ekirikworeka omuringo gw'osmosis omu buryo obwereire

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'ekyomunaana ari kutebeekaniza isomo aha miterere y'obuzimbe bw'obutofaali (cells) oburikukora ebindi, kandi yabaasa kwenda abegyesi kukwataganya okukura kw'omugasho kw'enkumbu y'omunda y'obutofaali (organelles) n'omurimo gwayo.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni enki aha bikorwa by'okwegyesa ebiija kureetera abegyesi kukurira aha kigyendererwa eki (okukwataganya structure n'omurimo)?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Yolesa ebifaananyi - kumanya omurimo gwa buri kimwe
B. Baha kubashushani aha microphotograph - obishoboorore omuhanda gw'okwiha ebintu
C. Reeta ekishushani ky'akashagama k'omubiri ekirikukora ebintu by'omunda n'ekindi ky'enyama - bagaragura omulingo ebintu ebirikubihweraana
D. Reeta ekishushani ky'akash cell ekirikukora eby'okuhisha n'ekindi - bashoborore omugasho gw'obwo bush cell kurugiira aha miteerere yaabyo

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi ni **D** - kuba kireetera abegyesi okushoborora omugasho (function) kurugiira aha miteerere (structure), ekyo nikyo kigyendererwa ky'okukwataganya structure n'omurimo.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa abuuza ahabw'oburamuby'omubiri obwa prokaryotic nibushobora bute kwegabura (okweyongera). Turikwetaaga enshoboroza erikugarukamu ekibuuzo ekyo omu mulingo ogurikwetegerezebwa kandi ogurikugira obuhame bw'ebirikukwataho.

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Erikugamba aha kwegaita - ekyo tikiri ekibuuzo

B. Erikugamba aha DNA - ekyo tikiri ekibuuzo eky'okwegabura/kweyongera

C. Erikugamba aha "okugabura orubaju" - ekyo tikiri mulingo gwa prokaryotic

D. Erikugamba aha binary fission (okweyongera kwa bayinari fisheni) - ogu nigwo mulingo gw'okwegabura/kweyongera gwa prokaryotic. DNA egikopiibwa, obuziba bugatenganwa, nibuzaara obutundu bubiri.

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni **D** - erikugarukamu ekibuuzo ky'omwegyeswa omu mulingo ogurikwetegerezebwa kandi ogurikugira obuhame bw'ebirikukwataho aha mulingo gw'okwegabura gwa prokaryotic.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha omugano gwa Dalton ogw'ebintu by'omunda. Omugano gwa Dalton gukwatiraine n'emisingye y'ebintu by'omunda (atomic theory), ogurikugamba ngu:
- Ebintu by'omunda birikukozibwa n'obwingi bw'atomi
- Atomi z'ekintu kimwe nizirikukwatiraine omu bwingi bw'oburemerezi
- Omu kwegaita kw'ebintu by'omunda, atomi nizirikukwatiraine omu mipimo emirikwetebwa

Ekigyendererwa ni "kushoboorora emisingye y'omugano gwa Dalton."

Nkureeba ebirikurugamu:

A. Kukora emishororongo ya kemikali - Eki kirikworeka omugano gwa Dalton aha mipimo y'atomi omu kwegaita
B. Kurikira omuhendo gw'obwingi - Eki tikirimu kukwatiraine n'omugano gwa Dalton
C. Kurikiriza omubuzo gw'ebipimo by'oburemerezi - Eki kirikworeka omugano gw'okukuuma oburemerezi omu kwegaita
D. Kubara oburemerezi omu mitwaro eshatu - Eki tikirimu kukwatiraine n'omugano gwa Dalton

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'omugano gwa Dalton ogw'ebintu by'omunda ni:

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda kumanya yaaba abegyeswa bategeire **omugasho gw'ebintu ebirukora eby'okurya** (the function/role of parts that make food).

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Yijuza ekishushani ky'ekimera, orageze ebintu ebi kikiraganisa n'ebi kirukukora omu kubumbabw'emuringo - Kino kirikworeka ebintu by'ekimera n'**emirimo gyabyo** (their functions)

B. Ha eby'okureeberaho by'ebintu ebirukora ebyokurya byabyo byenyine - Kino kirikuha amazina genyini, tikiriworeka omugasho/omurimo

C. Ebirugaaba omuhanda gw'ebyomeeri... - Kino kirikukurata aha byomeeri, tikiriha omugasho gw'ebintu

D. Shuuruura omukago hagati y'ebintu ebiramu ebiri omu mutego gw'ebyokurya - Kino kirikukurata aha mukago omu mutego, tikiriha omugasho gw'ebintu by'ekimera

Eky'okugarukamu **A** nikyo kihikire kuba kirikworeka ebintu by'ekimera (ebi kikiraganisa) hamwe n'**ebi kirukukora** (emirimo gyabyo/omugasho gwabyo).

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya aija kugamba aha kutebeekanisi eby'okushobora n'abegyeswa be omu itendekyero erikukwata aha bintu ebirikutunguura okukora kw'ebimera eby'okurya (photosynthesis). Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni kikuru ki aha bikorwa ebi omwegyesa arikukora ekirikubaasa kureetera eki ekigyendererwa kuhikiirira?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kugamba aha maani g'ekyanga hamwe n'ebyo twarikwenda kumanya - eki kirikukwata aha kutandika kwega

B. Kuteeka omuringo gw'okukora okushomesa omuti gukaba gukwesherezibwa omu mishana etari emwe n'emwe - eki kirikukwata aha kukora okushomesa n'okushobora

C. Ekibuuzo aha obururu, obushuushu n'omufuunjo omu photosynthesis - eki kirikukwata aha bintu ebirikutunguura

D. Ekibuuzo aha CO2 n'omuhendo gw'okukora photosynthesis - eki kirikukwata aha kutebeekanisi eby'okushobora (hypothesis)

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha "kutebeekanisi eby'okushobora" - eki ni hypothesis. Eky'okugarukamu D kirikworeka omuringo gw'okukora okushomesa ogukwatiraine n'okutebeekanisi hypothesis.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya ari kukora aha mugenzo gwa Darwin ogw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu. Ekigyendererwa ni kureetera abegi kwetegyereza ngu ebiriisa ebirikukwatana munonga omu kuhinduka kw'ebintu byabaire nibigabana izooba rimwe ery'enyima. Abegi abamwe tibarikwetegyereza eki ekirikugambwaho.

Nkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Taata ebiramu omuhendo kurugiirira aha kufaanana kwabyo omu mbeera y'omubiri - Eki kirikureetera abegi kureeba obufaanani bw'omubiri, ekirikubaasa kubareetera kwetegyereza obunywani.

B. Garukamu ebibuuzo kurugiirira aha kucweekereza ekicweka ky'ekikoni kya cladogramu - Eki kirikukoresa ekikoni ekirikworeka obunywani.

C. Yomba ekishushani kirikugaburamu eby'okureeberaho by'ebishagiro - Eki kirikworeka ebishagiro byonka.

D. Geranisiriza emikorogo ey'ebihimba ebiheraine omu bintu ebirukuumirweyo kugira ngu otandikeho obunywani bwabyo - Eki kirikureetera abegi kukora okucweekereza kw'obwomeezi, kugeranisiriza emikorogo y'ebihimba ebiheraine kugira ngu babone obunywani bwabyo.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikubaasa kureetera abegi kwetegyereza obunywani bw'ebiriisa ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'ina owa siniya ari kutebeekaniza isomo eriragira abegyereza kumanya omugasho gw'okugemba omu by'obushaho bw'abantu boona. Turikwetaaga kureeba ni kikorwa ki ekirikwija kugasira omwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'omukurrikuru w'eby'okwegyesa aha kumanya ebimanyiso bya sayansi.

Nkwetegereza eky'okugarukamu kyona:

A. Kurikiriza ebirikuruga omu kugemwa kurugiirira aha byahandiikwa by'okugezesa (Edward Jenner) - Eki nikyoreka omugasho gw'okugemba kurugiirira aha byahandiikwa by'abantu abakuru omu sayansi.

B. Kushwijuma obwingi bw'endwaara ezirikwata - Eki nikyoreka data/amakuru, kyonka tikiri kumanya omugasho gw'okugemba.

C. Kurikiriza omuhendo gw'abantu abahaire oburinzi - Eki nikyoreka ebirikuruga omu kugemba omu bushaho bw'abantu.

D. Kukora omurongo gw'ebiro by'okukura kw'ebintu bikuru - Eki nikyoreka amateka g'okugemba n'omugasho gw'abanyasayansi.

Ekibuuzo kirikwetaaga kumanya omugasho gw'okugemba omu by'obushaho bw'abantu. Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyoreka butereeire omuhendo gw'abantu abahaire oburinzi (ebirikuruga omu kugemba) omu bushaho bwabo.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikwegyesa aha muringo gw'amagi n'omuringo gw'enda. Omweeshure naagira ngu:
- Luteinizing hormone nikweyongera
- Amagi nikirekururwa
- Corpus luteum nikireebeka
- Corpus luteum nikitandika kureeta progesterone

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Kiki ekirikuzibuura okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa?

Ninkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Okubura kw'omwe aha mishangwa - Eki tikiri omu kugarukwamu kw'omweeshure

B. Okurikira aha emishonga ya gonadotropic - Eki tikiri omu kugarukwamu

C. Kutahoora omukago ahagati y'ebicweka by'okukura kw'amagi n'emibazi ya gonadotropic - Omweeshure yaagambiire aha LH (gonadotropic hormone) kandi aha okukura kw'amagi, aitu yaahooireho omukago ogu

D. Corpus luteum guriho gwenyine omu ibumba ry'omwisho - Omweeshure yaagambiire ngu corpus luteum "nikireebeka" kandi "nikitandika kureeta progesterone" aitu yaahooireho aha corpus luteum

Omweeshure yaagambiire ebintu bingi ebikwatiraine n'omuringo, ahabw'ekyo ekibuuzo nikigamba eki "ekirikuzibuura" - ekirikubura omu kugarukwamu kwe.

Eky'okugarukamu C nikigamba ngu omweeshure "kutahoora omukago" ahagati y'ebicweka n'emibazi - aitu yaahooireho.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya naija kutebeekaniza okushomesa okw'okubanza okw'okugyenda omu maisho kw'ebirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza omukago oguli hagati y'omulingo gw'okukora eby'okulya kw'ebimera n'omulingo gw'okuhuumura kw'obutonde bw'ebiramu obuto".

Ekibuuzo nikigamba aha murimo ogurikwija kumworeka okugyenda omu maisho kw'okushomesa oku.

Nkureeba ebyokugarukamu:

A. Ekicweka ky'okugyeragyeranisa - Eki nikigamba aha differences (enjawulo) enkuru
B. Empandiika ey'okusomesa - Egi neeragira omukago n'obutaro bw'emiringo egi
C. Ekipande ekiine emigyego - Eki nikireeta okwesigama kw'emiringo
D. Ekishushani ky'ebizimbe - Eki nikireeta ebintu ebikuru omu buri murimo

Ekigyendererwa ky'okushomesa nikigamba aha "omukago" (relationship/connection) oguli hagati y'emiringo egi. Ekyokugarukamu **B** nikireragira bulungi omukago ogu - nikigamba ngu oxygen oguva omu photosynthesis nigwo abantu birikuhuumura, kandi carbon dioxide oguva omu cellular respiration nigwo ebimera birikukoresa omu photosynthesis. Eki nikireragira obutaro n'omukago.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa yaabaire atekireho ekigyendererwa ky'okuba abegyesi bateekateeka kukwata aha bikorwa bya enzayimu ezirikukozesebwa omu kweyongyera kw'obwingi bwa DNA.

Ekibuuzo kye yabuuza kirikugira ngu: "Fludarabine gurikuremesa DNA primase. Kurugiirira aha bwamanya obu, ekicweka ki ky'okweyongyera kw'obwingi bwa DNA eki fludarabine erikukwataho?"

DNA primase ni enzayimu erikukora RNA primer (omusaizi gwa RNA) ogurikubanzaho okutandikira okukora DNA. Kuba fludarabine erikuremesa DNA primase, ekyo kirikutwara ngu erikuremesa okukora RNA primer.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwatanisa n'omurimo gwa DNA primase ni:

**A** - Shobora ekikorwa ky'omusaizi ekirikukwatanisa n'okukora RNA erikukoresibwa omu kubanza kw'okukora DNA

**A**

# Okwetegereza Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kirikubuuza aha muringo murungi gw'okukora ogurikwongyera aha etaabulo y'omugabo ogurikworeka obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba, kandi gukikora aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho "Okwombeka eby'okureeberaho ebirikushoboorora eby'obutonde bw'ensi eby'aha system y'eizooba".

## Okwetegereza Ebigarukamu:

**A.** Tebeekanisa ebirimu omu mw'etaafeeri omuri taabulo kuruga omu buceeri bukuru - Eki kirikukurataho okutebeekanisa ebintu omu muringo gwabyo.

**B.** Shutama omugazi gw'Ensi nk'ekipimo ekikuru omu meza, oreebeireho orukurato orundi orurikworeka omugano hagati y'omugazi gw'ebintu by'omu iguru ebirikushushana n'ogw'Ensi - Eki kirikukora ekipimo ekikwatiraine n'okworeka omugano.

**C.** Ngyenda ki erikukira enyakasheeshe yaitu obunene? - Eki ni kibuuzo kyonka, tikiri muringo gw'okukora.

**D.** Empandiika y'omubazi gw'amaani (Scientific Notation) - Eki kirikworeka omuringo gw'okuhandiika emigano mirungi munonga omu muringo murungi, ekirikukwatiraine n'okworeka obunene bw'ebintu by'omu iguru.

Ahabw'okuba empandiika y'omubazi gw'amaani (Scientific Notation) niyo erikoreshwa omu sayansi okworeka emigano mirungi munonga (nk'obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba), kandi ekibuuzo kirikukurataho okwombeka eby'okureeberaho ebirikushoboorora eby'obutonde bw'ensi, eky'okugarukamu ekirungi ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'abiri omu sekenda ari kutebeekanisa amasomo g'ekicweka kya Kinematics (omuringo gw'amaani). Naija kukora omurimo oguraagyezaho ebiri omu isomo, kurikukiriza aha bw'amaani oburi omu kalikula aha Mutindo gwa Saayansi.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Oruhe orurikukiriza omu bwengye aha bw'amaani obwo oburi omu kalikula?

Nkureeba eky'okugarukamu:

A. Okucumura ebizibu bya buri izooba - Eki nikigamba aha kukozesa amaani omu buzima bwa buri izooba

B. Okushoboorora oku omuringo gw'amaani gwateireho omu byafaayo by'abantu - Eki nikigamba aha kukurataho kw'amaani omu mbeera z'abantu

C. Okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa n'omuringo kureetsire obuhangwa obw'okushobora kupima omugabo gw'amaani - Eki nikigamba aha buhangwa bw'eby'obwomeezi n'okukura kwabyo

D. Omugyenzo gw'okugwa omu mwanya gw'obusheesho guruga n'oku gyesigamire aha bwangu bw'amaani - Eki nikigamba aha mbeera ezikwatiraine n'amaani g'okugwa

Kuba omwegyesa ari omu Kinematics (omuringo gw'amaani g'omugyegyo) kandi naija kukora omurimo oguraagyezaho, eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'okuraagyeza amaani g'omugyegyo ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza aha "ekiganisa" (limitation/problem) ky'okushushanisa amashanyarazi n'amaizi omu kwegyesa abegyesa.

Nkwetegyereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Tirikukora kukoresa ebikunizo by'amashanyarazi ebihingaanire - Eki tikiri ekiganisa ky'okushushanisa, kuba okushushanisa n'amaizi nikwo kukoresa ebikunizo.

B. Nikikugyema abegyesa kwikiriza ngu amashanyarazi nigabaasa "kushura" omu mutambi kwonka tigarikubaasa "kwambuka" - Eki nikyo ekiganisa ekikuru ky'okushushanisa oku, kuba amaizi tigarikubaasa kwambuka omu rubingo nk'oku amashanyarazi garikukora.

C. Tirikwikiriza abegyesa kukwataganya amagezi - Eki tikiri ekiganisa, kuba okushushanisa nikwo kukoresa kukwataganya amagezi.

D. Nikikuratiiza abegyesa okuteekateeka ngu amaani g'omuringo nigushushana n'omuguta gw'amaizi - Eki nikyo ekigyendererwa ky'okushushanisa, tikiri ekiganisa.

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Omwegyesa arikwetegyereza okutahurira kw'omwegi omu kugaragaza enjawulo eri hagati y'ebishushani by'obushuba (virtual images) n'ebishushani by'amazima (real images) omu ndorerwamu.

Ninkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Kirikugamba aha mbeera y'ebishushani - eky'obushuba kirikureebeka nk'ekiri enyima y'endorerwamu, n'eky'amazima kirikureebeka omu maisho g'endorerwamu.

B. Kirikugamba aha kuhinduka kw'ebishushani by'amazima (kuruga ahaiguru okuhika ahansi) obu ebishushani by'obushuba birikuruga omu bwengye.

C. Kirikugamba aha mbeera y'okureebeka - ebishushani by'obushuba nk'ebiri enyima y'endorerwamu, n'ebishushani by'amazima nk'ebiri omu maisho g'endorerwamu kandi nibishobora kworekwa aha kikoomi.

D. Kirikugamba aha kibanza ky'okukora ebishushani - ebishushani by'obushuba bikoleka omu kibanza ky'obushuba, n'ebishushani by'amazima bikoleka omu kworekwa kw'emisiri eyeretsire.

Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire kushoborora okutahurira kw'omwegi n'okwetegereza obuhikire bw'enjawulo eri hagati y'ebishushani by'obushuba n'ebishushani by'amazima nikyo:

**C**

# Okwetegyereza Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza aha bumanyi abanyeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu mashomero ga siniya abaine kuba barikumanya **kare** kubaasa kwetegyereza ebintu ebirikukwata aha mishana nk'okwerorera n'okucwekyera kw'omushana.

## Okwetooranisa Ebigaruzo:

**A. Okumanya ngu omushana nigwenda omu murongo ogugororokire**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru oburikukwata aha mishana, kandi ni bw'omusingi kubaasa kwetegyereza okwerorera n'okucwekyera.

**B. Okumanya ngu leza eriha omushana gw'ebara rimwe**
- Eki tikiri kituufu kandi tikiri ky'omusingi aha kwetegyereza okwerorera n'okucwekyera.

**C. Okwetegyereza omushana nk'omuyaga gw'amasannyalaze n'obushoboorozi**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru munonga oburikukwata aha fizikisi, kandi tikyarikuba ky'omusingi kw'abanyeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okubanza.

**D. Okwetegyereza emiringo y'omushana nk'omuyaga n'ekintu**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru munonga oburikukwata aha fizikisi, kandi tikyarikuba ky'omusingi kw'abato.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **A** - okumanya ngu omushana nigwenda omu murongo ogugororokire ni bumanyi obw'omusingi oburikubaasize abanyeshuri kwetegyereza okwerorera n'okucwekyera kw'omushana.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi w'omwaka ogw'abiri omu Physics arikwenda kwegyesa aha kigyendererwa: "Kwetegyereza amateeka ga Newton n'okugakoresa kushoboorora embeera eza buri izooba."

Turikwenda kumenya ni enshonga ki aha zirikukurugiraho ezirikworeka enyikiriza ez'obushuba ibiri ezirikubaasa kutaataagura omwegyeso gw'ekigyendererwa eki.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Obureiyo n'obuhinduko bw'omwanya nibimanyisa ekintu kimwe; amaani agurikukoresibwa kutaata ekintu nigashuuruurwa oburemeezi bw'ekintu ekyo.
- Eki kirikworeka enyikiriza ez'obushuba - obureiyo n'obuhinduko bw'omwanya tibiri kintu kimwe, kandi amaani tishuuruurwa oburemeezi.

**B.** Omubiri gwabaire nigumire, tihariho maani agurikora; okuhutaana nikubaho obutoosha omu muhanda gumwe n'okugyeenda.
- Eki kirikworeka enyikiriza ez'obushuba - omubiri ogurikugumira gushobora kuba n'amaani agurikora (balanced forces).

**C.** Omwanya gw'ekintu nigushobora kushobororwa kuraba omu buraayo bwagyenda kuruga aharikutaandikira; ebintu ebiriho byonka nibishobora kukoresa amaani.
- Ekisooka kirungi, kyonka ekibiri kirikworeka enyikiriza y'obushuba - ebintu ebitariho nabo bishobora kukoresa amaani (nk'omuheho).

**D.** Obuhabuzi buri buriire niburemesa okweyongyera omuhanda; amaani agaakoresibwe ekintu ekito aha kikuru munonga nigo mato okukira amaani ag'okugarukana ag'ekikuru aha kito.
- Eki kirikworeka enyikiriza ibiri ez'obushuba ezikwatiraine n'amateeka ga Newton.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omu mwaka ogw'abiri ogw'ahaiguru ari kukora ekikoreso ky'okushimira ekigyendererwa: "Kwoleka ngu nibetegyereza ngu okumanya ebiri omu bwengye nikuhinduka kandi nikweyongyera hamwe n'obuhame obusya."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni kiratwa ki ky'okushima ekirikukwata aha kwega kw'abanyeshuri aha kigyendererwa eki?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Shoborora omuhanda ogu bw'ensi yoona - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwengye

B. Shoborora omuringo ebintu by'omu bwengyerero byabaireho - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya

C. Geragyeranisa emigisha n'obugufu bw'emiringo etari emwe - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya n'okuhinduka

D. Shisha ebitebyo ebyakozirwe ekitebe ky'okushoborora - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwomeezi

Ekigyendererwa kikwata aha "okumanya ebiri omu bwengye nikuhinduka kandi nikweyongyera hamwe n'obuhame obusya."

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwengye hamwe n'obuhame obusya ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'abiri owa siniya arikwenda kukora okukebera okw'okubanza kw'okwetegereza kw'abeeshuri aha mbeera y'okugwa kw'ebintu. Ekibuuzo nikigamba ati: Murimo ki gw'okushishooreza oguraagira omwegyesa kutunga obuhame oburikukirayo oburungi aha kumanya kw'abeeshuri okw'okubanza aha mutwe ogu?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Okuta obuntu omu iguru n'okugyeragyeranisa - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza oburikuruga omu kukora kw'abeeshuri

B. Okuzamu bibuuzo n'okuteerereza obwire - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza oburikuruga omu kuteerereza n'okuzamu

C. Okurikira omu kishushani - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza oburikuruga omu kurikira

D. Okukora omumapu y'ebiteekateeko - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza oburikuruga omu kurikira ebiteekateeko

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi nikiba **A** - okuta obuntu omu iguru n'okugyeragyeranisa nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza oburikuruga omu kukora kw'abeeshuri okw'okwetegereza mbeera y'okugwa kw'ebintu.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa naabaza omunyeshuri aha ihangaanwa ry'omuguruko (Doppler effect) n'emigisha y'amaizi, kandi omunyeshuri naagarukamu ngu omushohori gw'okusaasaara kw'amaizi niguhinduka ahabw'okuba nigyesigamira aha muringo n'obureingwa bw'omugisha.

Enshobi y'omunyeshuri ni ngu yateekateeka ngu omushohori (wave speed) gw'amaizi niguhinduka omu Doppler effect, kwonka omu mazima omushohori gw'emigisha tiguhinduka - ekihinduka ni frequency (omuringo) n'obureingwa oburikurebwa n'omureebi.

Nkureeba ebigarukamu:

**A** - Tigamba bulungi, ahabw'okuba omuringo n'obureingwa nibihinduka omu mazima.

**B** - Yagamba ngu omuringo gw'amaloboozi tiguhinduka omu Doppler effect, ekyo nikitari kituufu.

**C** - Yagamba ngu obureingwa bw'omuyaga nibuhinduka kwonka omushohori tiguhinduka - ekyo nikituufu.

**D** - Yagamba bulungi ngu omushohori gw'okusaasaara tiguhinduka, kandi yabaza ebibuuzo ebirikuhabura omunyeshuri kwetegereza ngu frequency n'obureingwa nibihinduka kwonka omushohori tiguhinduka.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi nikyo **D** ahabw'okuba kyoreka bulungi ngu omushohori tiguhinduka kandi kyabaza ebibuuzo ebirikuhabura omunyeshuri kumanya enshobi ye.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogwa kabiri omu somero erishemereire ari kutebeekaniza isomo eririmu ekigyendererwa: "Okumanya obukuru bw'emiterere ya R nari S omu bizibo ebikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba"

Ekigyendererwa eki kirikwetaaga abegyirizibwa:
- Kumanya OBUKURU (importance/significance) 
- Bw'emiterere ya R na S
- Omu bizibo ebikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba (everyday life applications)

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kutebeekaniza makuru g'obushuuru - Eki kirikukurata theory yonka
B. Kucuubaaza migisha y'okukoresa emibazi - Eki kirikukurata examples y'emibazi
C. Kugaragura enshonga ezirikushushana n'ezitatushana omu miterere y'ebintu - Eki kirikukurata **obukuru** (differences in properties) bw'R na S stereoisomers omu bintu 5 ebikoresibwa buriijo (everyday use) nk'ibuprofen
D. Kukoresa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog - Eki kirikukurata nomenclature/naming yonka

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyo kihikire kwokka kuba:
- Kirikukurata OBUKURU (importance) - enshonga ezirikushushana omu properties
- Kirikukurata ebintu ebikoresibwa BURIIJO (everyday life)
- Kirikukurata R na S stereoisomers

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda kworeka abegi aha mitwarize y'ekikoroidi (colloid) kugarukamu okutari kumanya kw'omwegi. Turikubaasa omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikubaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa kukora eki.

Ninkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Koresa omugisha gwa Tyndall - Oku ni omurigo gw'obwomeezi ogurikworeka mitwarize y'ebikoroidi, ngu omusana gurikubaasa kubaasa kureebeka omu kikoroidi.

B. Gatangye omucweko gwa mayoneesi n'amaizi - Mayoneesi ni eky'okugarukamu ekimanyirwe ky'ekikoroidi. Okugitangya n'amaizi kureeta okureeba oburungi bw'ekikoroidi.

C. Yashushani omuhendo gw'akareebeka - Oku ni kwegyesa kw'obwomeezi obutorikukurataho.

D. Shisha omuringo gw'omukago - Oku ni kw'obwomeezi obukuru munonga, torikubaasa kwikiriza abegi bato.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisinga kubaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa kworeka mitwarize y'ekikoroidi omu buryo obw'okwega n'okureeba ni:

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa atunga ekizibu: abegyesa tibarikwetegyereza ahabwenki baine kuteekamu obugumi bw'ekyoma omu namba z'abaroma omu mbeera zimwechonka (omu kukoresa amakuru ga Stock).

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

**A.** Kuhandika ebishubo bya meto n'embeera y'okusaazibwa - Eki tikiri kukurataho aha kizibu ky'obugumi bw'ekyoma omu namba z'abaroma.

**B.** Kuhandika aha kaadi metal oxides, abegyesa bakuta ameiziina, kandi bagarukamu: "Ahabw'enki metal oxides ezirikwatanisa ezirikwombekwa zineiziina ryaazo ririhendaine?" - Eki kirikukurataho BUZIMA aha kizibu: kirikubagambira ahabw'enki ameiziina gaahendaine (ahabw'obugumi obutari bumwe bw'ekyoma).

**C.** Kuhandika fomura za dioxo na copper monoxide - Eki kirikukurataho aha bintu bibiri byonka, tikiri kukurataho aha kizibu ky'okutegeereza obugumi obutari bumwe.

**D.** Kuhandika ebyoma n'amaani gaabyo ag'okwegatta - Eki kirikukurataho aha kwegatta n'oxygen, nari tikiri buzima aha kizibu ky'obugumi bw'ekyoma omu namba z'abaroma.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukomaliza ekizibu ni **B** - kirikubagambira AHABW'ENKI ameiziina gaahendaine (ahabw'obugumi obutari bumwe).

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'eshomo ry'ahaiguru erya kabiri arikwija kukora n'abaana aha **bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura n'omugasho gwabyo**. Ekigyendererwa ni **okwikiriza ebyo esomo erikutsindika aha kumanya ebintu bya saayansi**.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A. Okukunkumura n'okubumbura eccupa ya soda** - Eki kirikworeka bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura (soda erikunkumura/okubumbura) kandi abaana nibakikora nibona omugasho gwabyo.

**B. Okucereeza ebimera eby'omu maizi** - Eki kirikukurata aha maani g'ekikoni, tikirikukurata aha bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura.

**C. Okureeba kacaayi k'entaano kahinduka amajeru** - Eki kirikworeka enkyukakyuka y'embeera (solid to liquid), kandi abaana nibakireeba nibona omugasho gw'okushushana.

**D. Okureeba kashushani k'oxyhemoglobin** - Eki kirikukurata aha kashushani, tikirikukurata aha bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura oburikubonekana.

Eky'okugarukamu **C** ni kyarungi zaidi kuba kirikworeka obunene **bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura** (entaano ehinduka amajeru) kandi **omugasho gwabyo** (okushushana), kandi abaana **nibakireeba** nibona enkyukakyuka egi - eki ni **kumanya ebintu bya saayansi** omu kwikiriza.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa secondary (mwaka ogwa kana) ateeraho ekigyendererwa: "Huura aha muganano gw'obwingi n'omugyenzo gw'ekibaro okubara pH omu mishonga etari y'amaani eya asidi na baze ez'emiringo etari emwe."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Okumanya ki okurikukurira okukuru abeeshuri kwakaba bamaze kutunga kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Omukago gw'amaani g'omushongi n'omusingi ogwaagwo ogurikugwaamu - Eki nikigamba aha muganano hagati y'amaani g'asidi/baze n'omusingi ogwaagwo (concentration)

B. Okwoikirira kw'eky'etantaro ky'ebintu ebirimu obusobozi bw'amaisho - Eki nikigamba aha indicators

C. Okugambira aha muhendo gw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu - Eki nikigamba aha conservation of mass

D. Okuteekateeka omubuzo gw'amaanyi g'ebirikiso - Eki nikigamba aha solubility

Ekigyendererwa nikigamba aha "muganano gw'obwingi n'omugyenzo gw'ekibaro okubara pH" - eki nikigamba aha relationship hagati y'obwingi (concentration) na pH value.

Kubaasa kumanya omuganano ogwo, abeeshuri nibateekwa kumanya ngu pH iri related na concentration y'asidi oba baze.

Eky'okugarukamu:

**A**

Kureeba ekibuuzo eki, omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abegi aha **ebintu ebirikugumya obuziizi bw'atomu**.

Obuziizi bw'atomu bugumibwa n'**amaani g'omutima gw'atomu** - amaani agava omu mutima gw'atomu (nucleus). Kuba abegi basobore kushoboorora ebintu ebi, nibateekwa kumanya engingo ezikuru ez'omutima gw'atomu.

Nkurugaho:
- **A** - Okuruguruka kw'ebintu - eki kirikukurata aha mbeera z'ebintu, tikirikukuratira obuziizi bw'atomu
- **B** - Omugatte gw'enzitoyo - eki kirikukurata aha bintu ebikuru, kyonka tikiri kintu ekikuru aha buziizi bw'atomu
- **C** - Namba y'obuto n'omubazi gw'enzitoyo - ebi birikukurata aha kwegarura atomu, kyonka tikiri byo ebikuru aha buziizi bw'atomu
- **D** - Omutima n'ebiragiro by'amaani by'akatomu - **EKI N'EKIKURU** kuba obuziizi bw'atomu bugumibwa n'amaani g'omutima, kandi abegi nibateekwa kumanya omutima gw'atomu n'ebiragiro by'amaani byagwo

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omurimo gurikugyenderera aha mugasho gw'okwega: "Kushoborora ebintu ebirimu obutonde bw'ebyomubiri kuraba omu mitwe yaabyo egirikukora"

Ekibuuzo nikiraba eki **tikishemereire** kuba kimwe aha birikugyendererwa omu kubaza omurimo ogu.

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Kumanya ebirango by'emikora - Eki kikwatiraine n'okushoborora ebintu

B. Orikushora ebintu ebirikukora omu muringo ogurikushushana - Eki kikwatiraine n'okushoborora

C. Orikushora ebintu ebirikukwatana omuhanda gw'okushushana kw'emiterere yabyo - Eki kikwatiraine n'okushoborora

D. Kutegyeka ebintu by'obutonde bw'ensi ebirikushushana orikukoresa amagara g'okutebyeka IUPAC - Eki nikyokushushana kw'amagara g'ebyomubiri (nomenclature), tikiri aha kushoborora ebintu kuraba omu mitwe yaabyo egirikukora.

Eky'okugarukamu **D** tikishemereire omurimo ogu kuba kyokushushana kw'amagara, tikiri aha kushoborora ebintu omu mitwe yaabyo.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Omwegyesa ari kukora aha mutwe gw'ebyaara n'amaani n'arikwenda kworeka ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara oburikukwatwa nibwisigamira aha bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano obwa buri kintu.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Okareesha obuzito obuhinguraine bw'amaizi na giriseri - Eki kirikukurataho ebintu ebitari bimwe (amaizi na giriseri), kandi kirikworeka ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara nibwisigamira aha kintu.

B. Amaizi omu bikopo ebiringaanire - bikopo bibiri ebiringaanire, obwingi bw'amaizi obuhwanaine (mL 50), kandi ekirikuhingurana ni material y'ekikopo (ndiba na bwaafu). Eki kirikworeka ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara oburikukwatwa nibwisigamira aha material (obwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano).

C. Amaizi agyezire na amaizi g'omunyo - Eki kirikukurataho ebintu ebitari bimwe.

D. Ekijiko ky'ekyuma omu amaizi - Eki kirikukurataho ekijiko n'amaizi, ebintu ebitari bimwe.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **B** - kunsonga ekyo kirikworeka bulungi ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara oburikukwatwa nibwisigamira aha bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano obwa buri kintu (material), omu kubasa obwingi bw'amaizi obuhwanaine omu bikopo ebiringaanire ebikoziirwe omu materials ezitari zimwe.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikutebeekanisa eishomo ry'okukoragana n'abanyeshuri ab'omumwaka gwa munaana aha mugingo ogurikukurataho: "Kutaho ebintu ebirikugyendererwa n'ebitarikugyendererwa omu bintu ebirikukwata aha kuhingura amata"

Omugingo gw'eishomo ni "kutaho" (okwawukanisa) ebintu ebirikugyendererwa n'ebitarikugyendererwa omu kuhingura amata. Ekyo kirikuragira okwawukanisa ebintu ebikuru n'ebitakuru omu mbeera y'okuhingura amata.

Nkureeba eky'okugarukamu kyona:

A. Shisha omu omuntu orikwerarikana n'omuntu orikurwaire sukaari - Eki kirikukurataho okwawukanisa abantu babiri
B. Yombeka omubazyo gw'omugisha gw'okunywa omwenge - Eki kirikukurataho omwenge, tarikukurataho amata
C. Yijuza etaabulo... y'omuceere - Eki kirikukurataho omuceere, tarikukurataho amata
D. Yijuza omuhanda gw'okwijuzamu ekitabo... aha bice by'omubiri ebihendekire omukura gw'ensigo - Eki kirikukurataho ebice by'omubiri n'ensigo, tarikukurataho amata

Eky'okugarukamu kyona ekiine akakwatirano n'amata nikyo:

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda kwegyesa aha "Ideal Gases" n'omukago oguri hagati y'obushuushu n'obwinganiza bw'empeho omu mbeera z'obwomeezi obwa buri izooba.

Nkwetegyereza buri ky'okureeberaho:

A. Ekyoma ekiteekyesa eby'omucwezi - Eki tikiri ky'obwomeezi obwa buri izooba
B. Oburo bw'ekyata ky'omugaati ogukozirweho omuseetwe - Omuseetwe (yeast) gukorera omu mugaati, gukora CO2, empeho ezirikwongera obu obushuushu bwongera (omu kuteeka), eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omukago hagati y'obushuushu n'obwinganiza bw'empeho

D. Ebipooli omu soda - Ekirikworeka empeho ezirikurugamu obu orikuguraho, eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omukago hagati y'obushuushu (pressure) n'empeho

Eky'okureeberaho ekiri kirungi okuhikaana n'amateeka g'empeho ya "Ideal Gases" n'omukago hagati y'obushuushu n'obwinganiza bw'empeho ni **B** - oburo bw'ekyata ky'omugaati, ahabwokuba ekirikworeka gye empeho ezirikwongera obu obushuushu bwongera (omu kuteeka), eky'okureeberaho ekiri ky'obwomeezi obwa buri izooba.

Omugurusi akozire okucungura aha atomu n'okubumbwa kw'emishuro. Abanyeshuri barikuikiriza ngu okubumbwa kw'emishuro ya cationi nikubaho ahabw'okuba atomu neyongyera "netunga" protoni. Eky'amazima: Cationi nikubumbwa ahabw'okuba atomu **eyahandura elektroni** (etarikwongyera protoni).

Omurimo ogurikubaasa kubashoboorora kuteegyereza gye ni:

**D** - Mugambire abeeshuri kugaragura omukago oguri ahagati y'emitwarize y'akatomu ka sodiumi etarikwetantara n'emitwarize ya sodiumi nk'ayoni, nibwo bareeba omuhendo gw'ebiprotani, ebirekitironi, hamu n'ebinyutironi bya buri emwe.

Ekyo nikibashoboorora kureeba ngu omuhendo gwa protoni gurikugarukana gumwe (11), ariko omuhendo gw'elektroni nigurikuhanduka (11 → 10), ekyo nikyo ekireeta charge ya positive.

Omwegyesa n'abaana b'ekikumi kya 7 barikwegyesa aha mutwe gw'omubiri ogutariikiriza endwaara. Ekigyendererwa ky'ekisomo ni "Kwetegyereza omuringo ogw'okutangira ogwa kashatu."

Omuringo ogw'okutangira ogwa kashatu (tertiary response) ni omuringo ogw'omubiri ogurwanisa endwara omu kihindo eky'okushatu - gushemereire kuba orikukwata aha **okwijukya** kw'omubiri n'engeri y'okurwanisa endwara ezaakire omu kihindo eky'okubanza n'eky'okubiri.

- Engeri omubiri ogurikwijukira endwara ezaakire
- Engeri ogurwanisa endwara omu kihindo eky'okushatu ogurikuba gw'amaani kuruta ogw'okubanza

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwata aha ni:

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

**B** - Erikugamba aha kuba orwoote n'akagyeenura akataine mirimo erikumanywa, kandi orubaju rwayo rurimu ebintu ebirikutandika omurimo gw'okuhindura

**C** - Erikugamba aha kuba obutaffa bw'omubiri obundi burimu ebintu ebirikwetagisa omu kukura kw'omwana omuhango, ekitarikubaho omu igi ry'omukazi

**D** - Erikugamba aha kuba orwofaafa orw'ekitima ky'eggi ry'omukazi rwine ebintu byona ebirikwetagisa okuhindura obuto obutari bumwe, ebirikubaasa kureetera obuto obumwe kukora emirimo bukaba burikukora

Ekibuuzo ky'omunyeshuri kirikugamba aha kubaza ahabwenki oburo bw'omukazi (egg cell) obutariho kantu bukoresibwa, hatariho oburo obundi. Eky'okugarukamu ekirikwetegyereza ngu oburo bw'omukazi burimu ebintu byona ebirikwetagisa okuhindura n'okukora emirimo y'okukura omwana.

Nkurata ekibuuzo ekihikire:

Omwegyesa yabuuza: "Nikimanyisa ki ngu okushomesa oburwanisi bw'endwara ya virusi kwoleka ngu IgG eriyo kandi IgM teriyo?"

Nkwetegyereza aha mazima g'emibiri erwanisa endwara (antibodies):
- IgM ni emibiri erwanisa endwara erikubanza kureeterwa omu kicweka ekya kubanza eky'oburwaire
- IgG ni emibiri erwanisa endwara erikureeterwa nyuma ya IgM kandi egumaho omu musaayi obwire burikurengaaho

Ku IgG eriyo kandi IgM teriyo, nikimanyisa ngu:
- Omuntu yaakaba arwaire omu bwire obuhise (IgM yaba eriyo)
- Omuntu yaakaba arwaire kandi akaba arikukira (IgG egumaho)
- Omuntu yaakaba arwaire omu bwire obuhise n'akaba arikumaraho obwire bw'ahaiguru munonga

Eky'okugarukamu D nikyo ekikwata aha mazima ahabw'okuba:
- Kyetegyereza ngu omuntu arikukira
- Kyetegyereza ngu IgM erugurwa okubanza, reero IgG
- Kyetegyereza ngu IgG egumaho omu musaayi obwire burikurengaaho

Ninkuteekateeka ekibuuzo eki:

Omurimo gw'okwega ni "Kwetegyereza oku bizimba bya kansa birikukura."

Kansa ni ndwaire erikuza omu kubyara kw'ebyanga obutakwatiraine - ebyanga birikweyabiza obutari bwine kandi bitakikoma. Ekyo kirikukurataho omu:

- Okweyabiza kw'ebyanga (mitosis) okutakwatiraine
- Okutakikoma kw'okweyabiza
- Okutakurikira emiringo y'omutendera gw'ekyanga

Kugira ngu abeeshuri basobore kwetegyereza oku bizimba bya kansa birikukura, nibashemereire kumanya engeri ebyanga birikweyabizamu omu mbeera y'obutofaali (mitosis), kuba kansa ni kuremererwa kw'okugabaganya emiringo egi.

Ekigendererwa eki kirikwetaaga abegyesa:
- Kwetegyereza oku entebe y'obwengye (sistema nerviosa) erikukwataganya ebikorwa
- Kwetegyereza embeera erikukikundukura omu bwengye
- Kwetegyereza omu bubaka oburikuhitsya obwengye omu mubiri gwona

C. Emiringo y'omubimbe by'obutofa bw'obwongo - Eki kirikukurataho obwongo n'enyihura

D. Omugisha gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebirungo by'okuhurira - Eki kirikworeka ebice by'entebe y'obwengye n'oku erikukwataganya

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **D** - kuba kirikworeka ebice byona by'entebe y'obwengye (omugisha gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebirungo) n'oku erikukwataganya omu kubumbabumba okugarukamu kw'omubiri.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ari kutebeekanisa isomo ry'ekibina kya 2 omuhanda gwa kabiri n'ekigyendererwa: "Kukoresa ebiragiro by'okukuumira omugufu omu nkora erugaire."

Ninkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Eby'okureeberaho by'okugongana omu mwoyo ogurikukuumirwa - Eki kirikukurata aha mwoyo, tikirikukurata aha biragiro by'okukuumira omugufu omu nkora erugaire.

B. Okukiriza oburemezi n'omuhindo gw'emotoka ezirikugongana omu rubindo orutaine obufindo - Eki kirikukurata aha kugongana kw'emotoka n'oburemezi, ekiri aha nkora erugaire kandi kirikukurata aha biragiro by'okukuumira omugufu (momentum).

C. Okukiriza omukago oguri ahagati y'amaani agataireho, obwire, n'empiso eyakwasirwe omubiri - Eki kirikukurata aha biragiro by'okukuumira omugufu (momentum = mass × velocity) omu nkora erugaire.

D. Okukiriza ebiriva omu kugongana kw'ebiti bibiri nibishushana nibirererera hatariho kuremererwa - Eki kirikukurata aha kugongana kw'ebiti omu nkora erugaire kandi kirikwereka okukuumirwa kw'omugufu.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisinga kukuratira ekigyendererwa ky'okukoresa ebiragiro by'okukuumira omugufu omu nkora erugaire ni:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa: "Okukoresa omuringo gw'omuyaga kworeka ngu omushana nigugaruka n'okucwekyera ku gurikukwata aha muhingo ogurikwegaanisa ebintu bibiri."

Omwegyesa yenda okukoresa ekikoreso ky'okwegyesa ekirikwangutsya okwetegyereza ebirimu.

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Ekitabo - kirikutwarira aha nshuraniso (theory/explanation)

B. Eky'omuringo gw'omukono ogw'ekombuta - kirikworeka omuhendo gw'amaizi g'omushana ogurikukurira aha ngata y'omumaisho g'ebintu bibiri

C. Eky'okureeberaho omu kiraasi - omutwe gw'ekyanga (laser) nigukuba amaizi, kirikubaasika kureebwa ngu omutwe gumwe nigwegyema (reflect) ogundi nigucwekyera (refract)

D. Omuringo gw'okushushana ogurikukoresa kompyuta - gurikworeka omushana gwaba gutaire aha mpaka z'ebintu bibiri

Ekikoreso ekirikwangutsya okwetegyereza ebirimu ni ekyo ekirikubaasisa abana kureeba n'okwetegyereza omu bwomeezi bw'okureeba. Eky'okureeberaho omu kiraasi (C) nikyangutsya okwetegyereza kuba abana barikubaasa kureeba omu bwomeezi bw'okureeba ngu omushana (laser) nigwegyema era nigucwekyera aha mpimo ezirikushobororwa.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugurusi areeba ngu abamu aha begyesa batarikubaasa kuhuura embeera z'ebiragiro by'amaani g'ensi yoona (okutangara). Omugurusi yenda eky'okureeberaho ekirikubaasa kukuza okwetegyereza kw'abegyesa.

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

**A.** Omugo gw'omunyeeto - gukora omugisha gw'okucunguruka omu muringo gw'ekizingo, kushushana n'amaani g'omugyego omu mbeera y'Okwezi.

**B.** Ekishushani ky'ekikamba ekirikuguruka - kireebwa nk'ekintu kigumire munonga, kirikirira Ensi, kizika ahaiguru, kireeta ebintu okugwa.

**C.** Omubumbi nigwo gwaagwa - guta omugazi, omuhindo gw'okubanza guri mwingi nigugwa hare, kora ekishushani aha bboodi n'enzira omubumbi guraakuratize.

**D.** Ekishushani ky'okugwa kw'eibuga - ruga oburemezi bwaryo n'obw'ensi, oburayyo aha makkati, amaani g'omugyegyeeto. Hanyuma ahindura ekishushani kworeka omukoranire ogw'amaani hagati y'okwezi n'ensi.

Eky'okureeberaho ekisinga kukuza okwetegyereza kw'abegyesa abarikutangara ni **D** - kuba kiratangaza omu buryo obwereere omukoranire ogw'amaani g'omugyegyeeto hagati y'okwezi n'ensi, kikozesa data n'ebishushani ebisobanufu.

**D**

Ninkuteekateeka ekibuuzo eki:

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha biteekerezo ebikurataho omu mutwe gw'ebicweka n'omuranga. Omugyezibwa ashemereire kubanza aha biteekerezo ebi bibiri ebirikuteeraho ombereho omu kwega ebindi.

Omu kwega ebicweka n'omuranga, biteekerezo by'omusingi ebirikubanza ni:
- **Amaani** (mass) - obuzito bw'ekicweka
- **Obureingwa/Oburemu** (volume) - ekifo ekicweka kyetwaramu

Ebyo ni biteekerezo by'omusingi ebirikuteeraho ombereho omu kumanya ebindi biteekerezo nk'omugara (density = amaani/obureingwa), okutetema, omulingo, n'ebindi.

Ninkureeba ebigarukamu:
- A: Omugara n'amaani - Omugara gukuratirwa ku maani n'obureingwa
- B: Omugisha n'obureingwa bw'omurambararo - unclear
- C: Okutetema n'omulingo - ebi ni by'okukurataho
- D: Amaani n'obureingwa bw'omuraranzi - Ebi ni biteekerezo by'omusingi

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'ekibiina ky'omwaka ogw'okubanza aheesiire enteekateeka y'okukora ekizibu ky'okugyezaho aha muheru gw'eishomo erikukwata aha bintu ebirikuhurira. Turikubaaza ni birikukurataho ebikorwa by'omwegi ebirikworeka ngu bamanyire ebireetera embeera ya Doppler?

Embeera ya Doppler erikukwata aha okuhinduka kw'omuringo (frequency) gw'omugisha (sound) oba omusana (light) omu muntu arikuguhurira ahabw'y'okugenda kw'ekintu ekirikukurugyaho omugisha ogwo.

Nkureeba ebigarukamu:

A. Erikukwata aha amaizi n'omuhindo - ti ky'embeera ya Doppler
B. **Erikukwata aha okuhinduka kw'omuringo gw'oruyo ahabw'y'okugenda kw'ekintu** - Eki nikyo embeera ya Doppler!
C. Erikukwata aha omutindo gw'okwehindura - ti ky'embeera ya Doppler
D. Erikukwata aha omururu - ti ky'embeera ya Doppler

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**B**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa owa secondary ari kutebeekaniza okushwijuma okwaheru kw'ekicweka ky'okwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya oxidation-reduction (redox). Ekigyendererwa ni: "Kwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya redox omu magara ga buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo omu bantu b'omuri obu bwire".

Ninkwetegyereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Kwangirika kw'ebintu by'ebyoma ahabw'enkuba erimu asidi - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba

B. Embeera z'omulingo gw'okutangaaza ogw'ebintu by'omwiijo - Eki tikiri ky'okuhindurana kya redox

C. Okuhindura ekikopo ky'emiyoboro y'amaizi kurugiirira omuyaga gwa okisijeni - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba (okutangaaza amaizi)

D. Omuhendo gw'amasannyalaze agahindurwa omu batiri - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba kandi kiri n'omugasho omu bantu

Ekibuuzo nikigamba aha "kwegerereza obuhame bw'okutungwa kw'ekigyendererwa" - ekyo nikyo kugamba omurimo ogurikukwasa abegyesa kwetegyereza redox omu magara ga buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo.

Eky'okugarukamu **D** nikyo kirikukwasa kwegerereza obuhame bw'ekigyendererwa, ahabw'okuba kirikworeka eby'okuhindurana bya redox omu batiri (magara ga buri izooba) kandi n'omugasho gwabyo omu bantu (teknolojiya).

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugendererwa ni "okukora n'okushoboorora data erikukwata aha miringo y'ebintu ebiriyo omu by'omubiri n'eby'obushoboorozi bw'ebintu ebiriyo."

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Ha data aha bw'okutemba kw'amazzi - abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe, tibakora data yabo benene.

**B.** Bacuubaaze aha bw'okureenga kw'amazzi - abaana nibakora obucuubazo bwabo benene (okukora data), kandi nibashuuruure obuba omu mbeera erikushushana (okushoboorora data). Eki nikwangiriza omugendererwa gw'okukora n'okushoboorora data.

**C.** Ha data aha bw'okutemba kw'amazzi - abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe, tibakora data yabo benene.

**D.** Ha data aha bw'okutenta - abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe, tibakora data yabo benene.

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyo kyonka ekireeta abaana okukora data yabo benene (okucuubaaza) n'okugishoboorora (kushuuruura obuba).

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akora okugyezibwa kw'okushishoora yaaba abegyendesereza nibabaasa kumanya emihinduko y'ebintu ebirikubaho omu bwengye bwabo. Omutwe gumwe gwayolesa emihinduko egi:
- Omuhinduko gwa sodium hydroxide na hydrochloric acid
- Okureebeka kwa hydrochloric acid kuruga omu hydrogen na chlorine
- Okureebeka kwa carbon dioxide kuruga omu carbon na oxygen

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni butumwa ki obu omwegyesa arakuha abegyendesereza kubahiga omu by'okwega ebirikushishoorwa?

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Ebirikugamba aha bintu ebirikumanyisa okubaho kw'emihinduko ya kemikali
B. Ebirikugamba aha bintu bya buri izooba n'emiringo gya kemikali
C. Ebirikugamba aha miringwa eretera ebintu bya buri izooba
D. Ebirikugamba aha engyenderwaho ezirikugyezibwa omu bikorwa bya buri izooba

Emihinduko eyorekwa (sodium hydroxide + hydrochloric acid, hydrogen + chlorine → hydrochloric acid, carbon + oxygen → carbon dioxide) TIRI emihinduko ya buri izooba - ni miringwa ya kemikali erikukoresa eby'okukozesa bya laboratoire/sayansi. Abegyendesereza barikushishoorwa ngu barikwega emihinduko ya kemikali, ariko emihinduko eyorekwa tiri eya buri izooba.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni:

**A**

Ekibuuzo kiri kukwata aha emisingi y'ekicweka kya Bernoulli.

Ekicweka kya Bernoulli kikwatiraine n'okutembera kw'amazi (fluid dynamics) kandi kikwata aha nkwaano eri omusingi gw'okugumiisiriza energy omu by'omwika ebirikwenda (fluids in motion). Ekicweka kino kikwata aha pressure, velocity, n'elevation omu fluid erikutembera.

Okusobora kwetegyereza ekicweka kya Bernoulli, abanyeshuri baine kumanya omusingi gw'okugumiisiriza energy - ngu energy y'omukago (kinetic energy) + energy y'okushushana (potential energy) + pressure energy = constant omu fluid erikutembera.

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**C**
